title: Unbreaking Determination
description:
Some enchantments are not meant to make an item stronger, but to make its strength endure.

Unbreaking now grows beyond its familiar limits. As the enchantment develops, each level greatly extends the life of the item it protects.

At Unbreaking V, an item's durability is preserved so completely that it can no longer be worn down through ordinary use.

There is no need to seek another enchantment to keep your favorite tools and equipment by your side. With enough time and use, Unbreaking itself can carry an item beyond the limits of its durability.

Perhaps some knowledge is better learned through patience than found in a book.
